name: California
programName: Medi-Cal with a Share of Cost (Medically Needy)

period.description: Your share of cost is a monthly amount; once your medical costs reach it, Medi-Cal pays for covered care the rest of that month.

submission.description: Usually your doctor or pharmacy reports what you paid or owe to Medi-Cal for you. You can also show bills to your county Medi-Cal worker; old bills from before you were eligible go to the county office.

notes: A paid receipt counts in the month you paid it, not always the month you got care.
Care from providers who do not take Medi-Cal can still count toward your share of cost.
If a bill is bigger than your share of cost, the extra can be used in a later month.
Send proof of health insurance premiums to the county and ask them to recalculate your share of cost.
